thread:
simon: Heads-up: CI turned red on macOS-arm64 after the deps merge (PR #912). macos-m1-runner failing in wheel build for pyarrow.

ci-bot: [job: macos-arm64/pytest] FAILED • https://ci.redwood.example/ci/12345

lisa: repro on my M1 laptop using tox env? can you paste the pip output?

simon: here's the failing bit:
```
Building wheel for pyarrow (pyproject.toml) ... error
  ERROR: Failed building wheel for pyarrow
  ERROR: Could not build wheels for pyarrow which use PEP 517 and cannot be installed directly
  clang: error: no such file or directory: 'libopenblas.dylib'
```

chandra: hmm looks like the new pyarrow 13 pulled in a transitive change to openblas packaging on ARM. Did the merge update any constraints file?

simon: only changed requirements.in (bumped pandas -> pulled pyarrow). No lockfile changes because we rely on CI pip-compile step.

mika: can someone try `pip install pyarrow==12.0.1` on macos-arm64 runner? if that works, it's likely pyarrow13.

lisa: I ran that locally, pyarrow 12 builds fine. 13 fails with same missing lib.

chandra: temporary mitigation: pin pyarrow==12 in the CI constraints and trigger a repin PR. I'll open one. In parallel can we rerun the macos job with `ALLOW_WHEEL_BUILD=true`? :eyes:

infra-bot: opened PR #918 to pin pyarrow==12.0.1 in ci-constraints.txt

simon: thanks. Also adding a note to the release checklist to check macos-arm64 wheels for heavy libs. Whoever wants to bisect the pyarrow release history, go for it — otherwise I'll merge the pin to unblock master.

mika: I'll take the bisect in the afternoon and report findings.

ci-bot: macos-arm64/pytest rerun queued by @simon

lisa: thanks all :thumbsup:
